findings: The frozen artifact contract requires a rear-mounted GPU interface that includes the PCIe-riser path and an installation sequence in which the riser is mounted before the GPU.
The frozen PRD constrains the conceptual GPU envelope to 180 x 115 x 40 mm and requires a back-to-back sandwich layout with explicit allowance for PCIe-riser bending and service access.

A nominal 200 mm cable is at the upper end of the requested 180-200 mm range, but final length cannot be approved until the motherboard-slot, tray-crossing, and GPU-receiver locations are fixed in CAD.

The provisional exact product identity is Cooler Master Riser Cable PCIe 4.0 x16 - 200mm, model MCA-U000C-KPCI40-200; no directly read external source was available in this correction pass, so purchasability and all product-specific mechanical claims remain unverified.

Receiver-PCB length, width, thickness, connector/cable exit orientation, mounting-hole coordinates, mounting-hole diameters, and manufacturer bend-radius guidance are unresolved; no enclosure mounting interface may be derived from guessed values.
recommendations: Carry Cooler Master MCA-U000C-KPCI40-200 only as the provisional 200 mm procurement target, not as an approved CAD interface, until an official product page or current supplier listing verifies the exact model and availability.
Require an official mechanical drawing, a dimensioned physical sample, or user-supplied caliper measurements for the receiver PCB and its mounting holes before creating bosses, slots, or keepouts.

Route the riser in CAD only after locating both PCIe endpoints; preserve a broad, untwisted service loop and replace that qualitative allowance with the manufacturer's minimum bend radius when documented.
Do not infer connector orientation from product photographs alone; verify GPU insertion direction, cable exit side, and motherboard-to-GPU fold direction against the exact purchased revision.

unresolved_decisions.question: Will the user approve Cooler Master MCA-U000C-KPCI40-200 after exact supplier and mechanical evidence is obtained, or require a different riser with a published receiver drawing?
unresolved_decisions.impact: This determines cable routing, receiver retention, mounting-boss geometry, keepouts, assembly order, and whether the 4.0 L enclosure target remains feasible.

unresolved_decisions.question: Should the final receiver be retained through verified PCB mounting holes or by a non-hole clamp/rail after the purchased sample is measured?
unresolved_decisions.impact: The choice changes printed-part geometry and load transfer; hole-based retention cannot be designed while hole spacing and diameter are unknown.

warnings: External supplier/manufacturer evidence was not read before the correction instruction to stop expanding research; current stock, price, supplier URL, exact connector orientation, receiver dimensions, mounting-hole geometry, and bend-radius guidance are therefore not established.
The provisional model identity must not be promoted to an authoritative BOM or enclosure constraint from this report alone.
The PRD's 180 mm GPU is only a conceptual envelope; final riser fit also depends on the selected GPU's PCB edge position, bracket geometry, and power-cable clearance.

candidates.selection_reason: The nominal 200 mm variant matches the requested length band, but suitability for the sandwich enclosure cannot be approved without exact procurement and mechanical evidence.
required_evidence: Current manufacturer or authorized-supplier product URL for the exact model
Official receiver-PCB dimension and mounting-hole drawing, or measurements from the purchased revision
Manufacturer cable bend-radius and fold/twist restrictions
candidates.supply_risk: No current supplier evidence or mechanically complete alternative was established in this correction pass.
